verified_facts.text: The hotel is located directly opposite the Royal Mews at Buckingham Palace.
verified_facts.excerpt: We are proud to be located directly opposite the Royal Mews at Buckingham Palace

verified_facts.text: The hotel is a five-minute walk from Victoria Station.
verified_facts.excerpt: just a five-minute walk from Victoria Station

verified_facts.text: Guests can easily witness the Changing of the Guard or stroll through St. James's Park nearby.
verified_facts.excerpt: guests can easily immerse themselves in the royal ambiance of the area, witnessing the Changing of the Guard or strolling through the picturesque St. James's Park

verified_facts.text: The Houses of Parliament, Big Ben, the London Eye and Buckingham Palace are a short stroll away.
verified_facts.excerpt: those looking for cultural sites will find the Houses of Parliament, Big Ben, the London Eye, and Buckingham Palace a short stroll away

verified_facts.text: The Royal Themed Double Rooms are each themed in honour of past British monarchs.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each room is regally themed in honour of past British monarchs, located directly opposite Buckingham Palace.

verified_facts.text: The Royal Rooms are adorned with portraits and royal accents as a tribute to the heritage of the British monarchy.
verified_facts.excerpt: Adorned with exquisite portraits and royal accents, each room is a tribute to the illustrious heritage of the British monarchy.

verified_facts.text: Royal Mews View rooms overlook the Royal Mews of Buckingham Palace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sleep like royalty, overlooking the Royal Mews of Buckingham Palace.

verified_facts.text: The Superior King rooms have a handcrafted, custom-made king Savoir bed.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sleep beautifully, with a handcrafted, custom-made king Savoir bed.

verified_facts.text: The building was built in the 1800s to host debutantes attending parties at the Palace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Built in the 1800s to host debutantes attending parties at the Palace

verified_facts.text: The hotel has traditional English decor including marble floors and crystal chandeliers.
verified_facts.excerpt: the property has traditional English decor that includes marble floors, crystal chandeliers

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites are filled with antiques and original artwork.
verified_facts.excerpt: plush rooms and suites filled with antiques and original artwork

verified_facts.text: The Palace Lounge serves afternoon tea with panoramic views over the Royal Mews of Buckingham Palace.
verified_facts.excerpt: offers a quintessentially English setting for afternoon tea, with panoramic views over the Royal Mews of Buckingham Palace

verified_facts.text: For the Golden Tips Tea, the tea is weighed at the hotel using golden scales and each tip is placed into a silver teapot with golden tweezers.
verified_facts.excerpt: this delicate tea is weighed with precision at The Rubens using golden scales; each tip is placed into the silver teapot individually with golden tweezers

verified_facts.text: The hotel has two restaurants, a lounge overlooking the Royal Mews, two bars and 24-hour room service.
verified_facts.excerpt: With two spectacular restaurants, a beautiful lounge overlooking the Royal Mews, two bars and 24-hour room service

verified_facts.text: The Cavalry Bar is inspired by royal pageantry, with rich red interiors, inventive cocktails, gin tastings and light bites.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by royal pageantry, The Cavalry Bar at The Rubens pairs rich red interiors with inventive cocktails, gin tastings and light bites

verified_facts.text: The English Grill offers refined British cuisine made using English produce.
verified_facts.excerpt: enjoy refined British cuisine made using the finest English produce

verified_facts.text: Through a partnership with Historic Royal Palaces, guests can get a limited allocation of complimentary tickets to attractions including the Tower of London, Hampton Court Palace and Kensington Palace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Through our partnership with Historic Royal Palaces, guests can enjoy a limited allocation of complimentary tickets to renowned attractions including the Tower of London, Hampton Court Palace and Kensington Palace.

verified_facts.text: The complimentary Historic Royal Palaces tickets are offered first-come, first-served and subject to availability.
verified_facts.excerpt: complimentary tickets are offered on a first-come, first-served basis and are subject to availability

verified_facts.text: Guests can design a bespoke seven-course menu with the Executive Chef, sourcing ingredients at Borough Market.
verified_facts.excerpt: Design a bespoke seven-course menu with our Executive Chef, sourcing ingredients at Borough Market.

verified_facts.text: A resident artist, ShelleyTheArtist, can create bespoke personal or family portraits by appointment.
verified_facts.excerpt: We are delighted to introduce ShelleyTheArtist, who is available to create bespoke personal or family portraits, crafting a truly unique memento. By appointment only.

verified_facts.text: The Family Suites and Master Suites accommodate two adults and up to two children under 12 on rollaway beds.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Family Suites and Master Suites are thoughtfully designed for stays with children, comfortably accommodating two adults and up to two children under 12 on rollaway beds

verified_facts.text: Family wings combine rooms through a private central door.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our family wings are designed for togetherness with space to unwind, combining rooms through a private central door for a connected yet comfortable stay.

verified_facts.text: The team can prepare cots, high chairs and extra beds in advance and arrange babysitting on request.
verified_facts.excerpt: from cots and high chairs to extra beds and thoughtful child-friendly touches, and can arrange trusted babysitting services on request

verified_facts.text: Young guests can have a complimentary Pastry Chef Experience with biscuit and cupcake decorating.
verified_facts.excerpt: Complimentary Pastry Chef Experience for young guests, with biscuit and cupcake decorating

verified_facts.text: Interconnecting rooms, interleading rooms and family wings must be booked directly through the reservations team.
verified_facts.excerpt: must be booked directly through our reservations team

verified_facts.text: Lift access and accessible accommodation options are available.
verified_facts.excerpt: Lift access and accessible accommodation options available

verified_facts.excerpt: part of The Red Carnation Hotel Collection
